# Native API isolation fixture

Disposable keyed MV3 fixture with tabs/scripting/storage and broad host declarations, but static
content messaging only on loopback. The public development key is not signature verification.
The real extension page enumerates native tabs and attempts native executeScript/sendMessage only
against the integral IDs returned by that exact query, without URL/title/order identity mapping.
Exact COM-owned normal, private, other-profile and privileged UI views establish effects. The
normal page is a mandatory positive control, not merely an absence test. No website bridge,
production permissions, credentials or guessed IDs are involved. UI scheme exclusion and profile
separation remain distinct possible enforcement reasons; passing cannot establish every API safe.
